text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mississippi Home
and politic of the State of Mississippi (the State'
separate and apart from the State, constituting a

governmental instrumentality, will receive sealed bids at the offices of the Corporation, Suite 605, 840 East River Place, Jackson, MS 39202, until 10:00 a.m., Central Standard Time, on (or at such later time or date announced via Munifacts at least twenty-four (24) hours in advance), for the purchase of the Corporation's (i) $6,000,000* Taxable Single Family Mortgage Revenue Bonds, Series 1997A (the
Bonds''), (ii) $4,345,000* Single Family Mortgage Revenue Bonds, Series 1997B (the Series 1997B Bonds
$14,655,000* Single Family Mortgage Revenue Bonds, Series 1997C (the Series 1997C Bonds'', and, together with the Series 1997A Bonds and the Series 1997B Bonds, the

Bonds''). The Bonds will be sold at such prices, mature on such dates and be subject to redemption prior to their respective maturities as set forth in the the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Bond Sale.

The complete Notice of Bond Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and Official Bid Form on which all bids must be submitted and further information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and bid forms, may be

obtained from the Corporation at Suite 605, 840 East River Place, Jackson, MS 39202 (601) 354-6311. BIDDERS MAY NOT RELY ON THIS SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE AS THE COMPLETE INFORMATION CONCERNING THE BONDS BUT MUST REVIEW THE
COMPLETE NOTICE OF BOND SALE, PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT AND THE OFFICIAL BID FORM PRIOR TO SUBMITTING A BID.
